crossRefs.note: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

translations.web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
translations.bsb: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
translations.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell
